speaker: President Rosemary K. Chibota
title: A Child of God
session: Sunday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

points.text: President Rosemary K. Chibota spoke about “A Child of God”.

quotes.text: The Savior Jesus Christ perfectly exemplified this principle. Throughout His ministry, He truly saw the people around Him. He saw the woman at the well, the leper, the blind man, and the child. Where others saw labels, He saw beloved sons and daughters of God. Even of the rich young man who later walked away from Him sorrowing, the scriptures say, “[And] Jesus beholding him loved him.”
quotes.speaker: President Rosemary K. Chibota
quotes.session: Sunday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: The good Samaritan also chose to see. Rather than allowing labels or differences to distract him, he saw a child of God in need and acted. The Savior’s example and the good Samaritan’s compassion are not beyond our reach. Often, helping others feel seen as children of God begins with something as simple as learning their name.
quotes.speaker: President Rosemary K. Chibota
quotes.session: Sunday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: President Dallin H. Oaks reminded us that “all mortals are beloved children of God.” As mission leaders, we found that missionaries who understood and taught this truth were more effective in helping others come unto Christ.
quotes.speaker: President Rosemary K. Chibota
quotes.session: Sunday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: I plead with you as disciples of Jesus Christ to pray to see others as He sees them and to treat them accordingly. Remember, “Jesus said love ev’ryone; treat them kindly too.” When we see others through the Savior’s eyes, love and service naturally follow. President Spencer W. Kimball taught, “God does notice us, and … it is usually through another person that he meets our needs.”
quotes.speaker: President Rosemary K. Chibota
quotes.session: Sunday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Seeing others as children of God also influences the way we see ourselves, yet the world encourages us to see ourselves and others differently. The world invites us to focus on labels rather than eternal identity.
quotes.speaker: President Rosemary K. Chibota
quotes.session: Sunday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Like many people, I have sometimes viewed myself through the lens of such labels. When President Oaks extended my new calling, he told me, “You’ve been called for who you are. The Lord knows you.” In that moment I was reminded that God’s view of us is always more complete and more hopeful than our own. This eased my feelings of inadequacy.
quotes.speaker: President Rosemary K. Chibota
quotes.session: Sunday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: President Russell M. Nelson taught us that embracing our divine identity influences every major decision in our lives. As we seek the Savior’s perspective, He will often guide us to those who need to be seen.
quotes.speaker: President Rosemary K. Chibota
quotes.session: Sunday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: My dear friends, I leave you a final sawubona. I see you. More important, your Heavenly Father sees you. Your Savior, Jesus Christ, sees you. They know your name, your circumstances, your gifts, and your divine potential.
quotes.speaker: President Rosemary K. Chibota
quotes.session: Sunday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference
